name: Webixso – WordPress Social Media Auto Post & Scheduler
author: Webixso

sections.description:
Webixso is a powerful WordPress social media plugin that automatically publishes your posts, WooCommerce products, and any custom post type content to Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest, YouTube, X/Twitter, and more. Connect your social media accounts in minutes and start sharing your WordPress content with custom captions, professional design templates, dynamic product variables (price, discount, stock), and per-account automation rules.

Start free with up to 15 social media posts per month and unlimited social accounts — no per-account fees, no artificial limits.

See our quick start tutorial to auto publish your WordPress content:

Why Choose This Social Media Auto Poster?

Unlike basic WordPress to Facebook or WordPress to Instagram plugins, Webixso gives you complete control over how your content appears on each social network. Customize captions per account, attach professional design templates, schedule auto posting intervals, and filter which content goes where — all from one plugin.

Simple Setup — No API Complexity

Forget about App IDs, OAuth tokens, and complicated authorization processes. Connecting your social media profiles happens in just a few clicks through your Webixso account dashboard. Install the plugin, click Connect with Webixso, sign up or log in, and authorize — the entire setup takes minutes, not hours.

Once connected, simply select which social profiles to use in the WordPress plugin, configure your captions and design preferences, and your social media automation is ready to go.

Unlimited Social Media Accounts

Add as many social media profiles as you need. Webixso does not charge per connection or impose account limits. Link all your profiles through the Social Profiles section on webixso.com and manage every one of them from a single WordPress plugin.

Per-Account Customization

Open any account’s settings to configure:

  • Custom captions tailored for each specific social media profile.
  • Design templates to give every post a professional, branded look.
  • Auto posting toggle to share content automatically when you publish.
  • Category and tag filters so only the right content reaches each network.
  • Daily posting limits to control how frequently content is shared.

Auto Post to Multiple Social Networks

Instagram Auto Post
Automatically share your WordPress posts to Instagram with image optimization and caption formatting specifically designed for Instagram’s requirements.

Facebook Auto Post
Share WordPress posts to Facebook Pages with custom captions, images, and link previews. Keep your community updated without lifting a finger.

LinkedIn Auto Post
Publish professional content to LinkedIn company pages and personal profiles with full image and link preview support.

X / Twitter Auto Post
Auto publish to X/Twitter with optimized messaging and media attachments. Still fully working after the API changes.

Pinterest Auto Post
Share visual content from your WordPress site to Pinterest boards automatically with proper image optimization and pin descriptions.

YouTube Auto Post
Cross-post your WordPress content to YouTube with optimized formatting and media support.

And More
Webixso continues to add new social networks. Connect any supported platform from your Webixso dashboard and it will appear in your WordPress plugin automatically.

Professional Design Templates

Create stunning, professional social media posts using the Webixso image editor on webixso.com. Choose from ready-to-use templates or build a design from scratch.

Dynamic Placeholders
Mark parts of your design as dynamic so they sync with your WordPress content automatically:

  • Title placeholder — Pulls the post title from your site. Set a character limit in the design and longer titles will be truncated with an ellipsis automatically.
  • Image placeholder — Merges your uploaded design dimensions with the image from your site. If your image is square the result is square; if it is rectangular, it stays rectangular. Your original aspect ratio is always preserved.

How to Use Designs
1. Create or edit a design template in the Webixso editor on webixso.com.
2. Mark your text and image elements for automation using the right-hand panel.
3. Save the design.
4. In your WordPress plugin, open the account settings and toggle on Share with design.
5. Select your saved design and hit save.

From that point on, every post shared through that account will automatically feature your professional layout.

WooCommerce Social Media Auto Post

Turn every new WooCommerce product into an Instagram post, Facebook post, Pinterest pin, LinkedIn update, or X/Twitter tweet — automatically. Webixso is a complete WooCommerce social media plugin and WooCommerce marketing solution that detects your store and pushes product listings straight to the social networks that drive the most traffic and sales.

Why store owners use Webixso for WooCommerce:

  • Auto share WooCommerce products the moment they are published, updated, or restocked.
  • Promote WooCommerce sales by auto posting discounted items with the sale price, regular price, and discount percentage pre-calculated.
  • Schedule WooCommerce posts using account-level daily limits and the built-in automation runner so large catalogs are shared without flooding your followers.
  • Share WooCommerce products to Instagram and Facebook with product images, price, and SKU rendered on a branded design template.
  • Save hours of manual product marketing — every new SKU becomes a finished social post without opening a second app.

Dynamic product variables for design templates

When a product is shared with a design template, Webixso automatically populates the template with real product data from your store:

  • product_name — product title.
  • product_description — short description (falls back to long description).
  • price — current selling price (no trailing zero decimals).
  • regular_price — original crossed-out price.
  • sale_price — active sale price.
  • discount — calculated discount percentage (e.g. %25).
  • stock — stock status text or available quantity.
  • sku — product SKU.
  • category — product category names from product_cat.
  • brand — brand name when a WooCommerce brands plugin is active (WooCommerce Brands, Perfect Brands, YITH).
  • image — featured product image.

Build the design once in the Webixso editor, map those variables to your layout, and every product you publish becomes a ready-to-post sales banner.

Smart defaults for ecommerce

  • Works with simple products, variable products, and any custom WooCommerce product type.
  • Pulls values through WooCommerce APIs (wc_get_product, wc_price, wc_get_price_decimals) so currency, decimal separator, and tax settings follow your store configuration.
  • Automatically maps the {categories} and {tags} caption placeholders to product_cat and product_tag, so your hashtags and breadcrumbs always reflect the right taxonomies.
  • Fully filterable via webixso_design_variables for advanced use cases (custom fields, ACF, additional attributes).

Custom Post Type Support

Webixso is not locked to blog posts. Out of the box it supports every public post type registered on your site — WooCommerce products, portfolio items, events, courses, recipes, real estate listings, you name it. If a post type is public and has a UI, Webixso can share it.

  • The share sidebar and Share Again button appear on every supported post type editor screen.
  • Automation rules (auto post, schedule, daily limit) run for all supported post types.
  • Category and tag template placeholders use the right taxonomy per post type (for example product_cat/product_tag on WooCommerce products).
  • You can disable Webixso on specific post types from the plugin settings if you only want to share some of them.

How to exclude a post type from Webixso

  1. Go to Webixso → Settings → General.
  2. Enable the Exclude specific post types toggle.
  3. Select the post types you want to skip from the dropdown — they appear as removable chips.
  4. Save. Webixso will now ignore those post types everywhere (sidebar, automation, dashboard listings).

Leave the toggle off to keep every public post type supported, which is the default.

Facebook Link Sharing Mode

Facebook accounts can be configured to share posts either as image posts (the default, with or without a design) or as native link posts with a rich link preview card generated by Facebook. Link sharing is perfect for publishers and news sites that want the preview image pulled from Open Graph metadata and the clean “article + description” layout.

Switch between Image sharing and Link sharing per Facebook account under the account’s settings. When link sharing is active, Webixso sends the post URL as a native link, strips duplicate URLs from the caption, and skips the featured image requirement.

Share from the WordPress Editor

Pick connected social media accounts directly from the post editor sidebar. Select one or multiple profiles, then publish your WordPress post — it gets shared instantly. When a share succeeds, you receive a clear notification confirming it reached your networks.

Need to share a post again? Use the Share Again button right from the sidebar.

Smart Automation Rules

Configure automatic sharing rules so your content goes out without manual effort:

  • Enable auto posting per account so new posts are shared the moment they go live.
  • Filter by categories and tags to ensure only relevant content reaches each social profile.
  • Set daily limits to control posting frequency and prevent over-posting.
  • Configure server cron for accounts with daily limits to ensure reliable, scheduled delivery.

How to Set Up Auto Posting

  1. Go to Webixso → Accounts in your WordPress admin.
  2. Click the gear icon on the account you want to automate.
  3. Toggle on Auto Posting.
  4. Optionally set category/tag filters and a daily posting limit.
  5. If you set a daily limit greater than 0, configure a server cron as described in the settings page.
  6. Save your settings.

New posts matching your rules will be shared automatically.

How to Filter Posts by Category or Tag

Only publish certain posts to specific social media accounts:

  1. Open the account settings (gear icon) for the desired profile.
  2. Select which categories or tags must be present for auto posting.
  3. Save your settings.

Now only posts matching your criteria will be auto posted to that account.

How to Stop Auto Posting for Individual Posts

Override automatic posting on a per-post basis:

  1. Edit any WordPress post.
  2. In the Webixso sidebar panel, deselect the accounts you do not want to share to.
  3. Publish or update the post.

This gives you complete control over which posts get shared to social media.

Generous Free Plan

Webixso includes a free starter plan with up to 15 shared posts per month. Connect unlimited accounts, try design templates, and prove the workflow before you scale. We are working hard to bring even more features to the table — let us know what you would like to see next.

External Services

This plugin connects your site to the Webixso platform in order to create and publish social media posts.

  • What the service is used for

    • Fetching your connected social media accounts and design templates.
    • Creating and publishing posts (with or without designs) to the selected social media accounts.

  • What data is sent and when

    • When you connect your site and manage accounts, the plugin sends connection/authentication data and basic site context (such as site URL) to the Webixso API to validate access and list available accounts and designs.
    • When you share a post (manually or via automation), the plugin sends:
    • Post content pieces (title, excerpt or trimmed content, categories and tags, permalink URL).
    • Information about the selected social account IDs (and, where relevant, page/board identifiers).
    • Optional image URL (featured image or first image in the content).
    • When automation is enabled, this data is sent in the background according to your configured schedule and rules.

  • Where the data is sent

    • All API requests are made to the Webixso API endpoint at https://webixso.com (for example, the base URL used by this plugin is https://webixso.com/api/v1/external).

  • How to revoke access

    • You may revoke access at any time by either clicking Disconnect in the plugin’s settings screen or revoking access from your Webixso account on webixso.com.

  • Terms of Service and Privacy Policy

    • By using this plugin, you agree to the Webixso platform’s own terms and privacy policy for how data is processed and stored.
    • You can review those policies on the Webixso website in your account area or the legal/terms section.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/webixso directory or install it through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Webixso → Settings and click Connect with Webixso.
  4. If you are new, sign up for a free account on webixso.com. Otherwise, log in.
  5. Authorize the connection to link your site.
  6. Head over to the Social Profiles section on webixso.com to connect your social media profiles.
  7. Back in WordPress, go to Webixso → Accounts and click Add Account to see your linked profiles.
  8. Configure captions, design templates, and automation rules per account using the gear icon.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Webixso account?

Yes. You need a free or paid account on https://webixso.com to connect and manage your social publishing settings.

Is there a free plan?

Yes. The free starter plan includes up to 15 shared posts per month with unlimited social media accounts. No credit card required to get started.

How many social accounts can I connect?

There is no limit. You can connect and manage as many social media accounts as you need — Webixso does not charge per connection.

Do I need to enter an API key manually?

No. Manual API key entry is no longer required. Click the Connect with Webixso button, sign up or log in, and authorize the connection — all in one flow.

How does automatic sharing work?

You can enable auto posting per account and optionally filter by categories and tags. For accounts with a daily limit greater than 0, you must also configure a server cron as described in the settings page.

Can I customize how my posts look on each social network?

Yes. Each account has its own caption settings and optional design template. You can create professional layouts in the Webixso image editor with dynamic placeholders for your post title and image.

Which social networks are supported?

Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest, YouTube, X/Twitter, and more. New networks are added regularly through the Webixso platform.

Can I share a post to multiple accounts at once?

Yes. Select multiple accounts from the post editor sidebar and all selected profiles will receive the post when you publish.

Can I re-share an already published post?

Yes. Use the Share Again button in the post editor sidebar to re-share any post to your connected accounts.

What happens if my free monthly balance runs out?

You will receive a notification in your WordPress admin letting you know your balance is depleted. You can upgrade your plan on webixso.com or wait for the next monthly cycle.

What if a social media connection is disconnected?

The plugin displays a notification alerting you when a social media connection is disconnected so you can re-authorize it from your Webixso dashboard.

Does Webixso work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Webixso is a full WooCommerce social media plugin. The share sidebar appears on every product editing screen, automation rules run on product publish, and design templates automatically receive product data (title, description, price, sale price, discount, SKU, stock, category, brand, image). You can auto post WooCommerce products to Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest, and X/Twitter with zero extra setup.

Can I auto post WooCommerce sale prices and discounts?

Yes. When a product is on sale, Webixso passes the sale_price, regular_price, and a calculated discount percentage (for example %25) to your design template. Build one sale banner template and every discounted product is shared with the correct numbers automatically.

Which WooCommerce product types are supported?

Simple products, variable products, and every custom WooCommerce product type are supported. Values are pulled through the official WooCommerce APIs, so currency, decimal separator, tax display, and stock settings follow your WooCommerce configuration.

Does it support brand plugins for WooCommerce?

Yes. Webixso automatically detects the product_brand (WooCommerce native Brands), pwb-brand (Perfect Brands for WooCommerce), and yith_product_brand taxonomies and populates the brand template variable if any of them is active.

Can I share custom post types (CPT), not just blog posts?

Yes. Webixso works with every public custom post type by default — products, portfolio, events, courses, real estate listings, and more. You do not need to write any code. If you want to restrict it, go to Webixso → Settings → General and turn on Exclude specific post types to pick the post types that should be skipped.

How do I stop Webixso from running on a specific post type?

Open Webixso → Settings → General, enable the Exclude specific post types toggle, and select the post types you want to hide. The share sidebar will disappear from those editors and automation will ignore them. Toggle it off to restore the default (all public post types supported).

Can I send a post URL as a Facebook link post instead of an image post?

Yes. Each Facebook account has a Sharing Type option: Image sharing (current behaviour, with or without a design) or Link sharing (native Facebook link post with link preview card). Switch modes per account from the account settings screen.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Added WooCommerce social media support: auto post WooCommerce products to Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest and X/Twitter with product-aware design variables (product_name, product_description, price, regular_price, sale_price, discount, stock, sku, category, brand, image).
  • Added custom post type (CPT) support: the share sidebar and automation now run on every public post type out of the box (products, portfolio, events, courses, real estate and more).
  • Added a new Supported Post Types setting so admins can exclude specific post types from Webixso without losing backward compatibility.
  • Added a Facebook Sharing Type option per account — pick between Image sharing (existing behaviour) and Link sharing (native Facebook link preview post).
  • Added webixso_design_variables, webixso_placeholder_taxonomies, webixso_supported_post_types, and webixso_available_post_types filters for developer extensibility.
  • Improved caption placeholders: {categories} and {tags} now automatically map to product_cat / product_tag on WooCommerce products and to the matching taxonomy on custom post types.
  • Improved dashboard: the “Recently Shared Posts” list now includes every supported post type, not only blog posts.
  • Improved design selection UI so only the active template shows a selected indicator.
  • Fixed a price formatting issue where the currency symbol was rendered as an HTML entity (e.g. ₺) instead of a clean ₺.

1.0.2

  • Added a new Connect with Webixso button for one-click site connection through webixso.com.
  • Added social media profile images for each connected account for clearer account visibility.
  • Added meaningful notifications to alert users when account balance is depleted or a social media connection is disconnected.
  • Improved onboarding and installation flow by removing manual API key entry.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
